title: Local Assets Demo
description: Uses your own images/videos from input/visuals/ instead of fetching from stock providers. Files are distributed round-robin across scenes. Use localAssets to specify exact files or autoLocalAssets to use everything in input/visuals/.
script:
First scene using my own image or video. [Visual: local-first-scene]
Second scene with another local file. [Visual: local-second-file]
Third scene falls back to this description if no local file. [Visual: local fallback scene]
